messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 429/500 errors for org 'yukon-analytics' (org_id=yukon-01). 1m QPS 560 -> threshold breached. Impact: coupling-heavy endpoints (chat.generate).

sophie (oncall-sre): on it, looking at ingress and rate limiter metrics. paging runtime team @jay

jay (runtime-eng): i'm awake, joining. do we have spike source? any large batches?

marco (support): customer reported slow responses ~10m ago, they mentioned a nightly enrichment job started early today.

sophie (oncall-sre): seeing sustained burst of long-context chat sessions from a handful of org tokens. RL is tripping and cascading into tail latency -> 500s. need emergency mitigation while we investigate.

jay (runtime-eng): propose temporary org-level rate bump + short quota lift to prevent 5xx while we throttle heavy prefixes. plan: set org burst qps=800 for 30m and enable prefix KV caching for that org. rollback at 30m or earlier. ok?

sophie (oncall-sre): +1. runbook: use admin console or CLI. marco, leah, notify customer about temporary change. exec command below:

deploy-bot: ````
redwood admin org-rl set --org yukon-01 --mode burst --qps 800 --duration 30m --reason "prod spike: nightly job" 
````

jay (runtime-eng): executing now. applying RL override and enabling lightweight prefix cache for yukon-01. will tag change with incident id.

deploy-bot: change_applied: org=yukon-01 action=rl_override qps=800 duration=30m id=inc-6072136543 user=jay

sophie (oncall-sre): monitoring telemetry. bringing up a short dashboard: token errors, p50/p95 latency, backend retries.

marco (support): reaching out to contact at Yukon, asking them to pause the enrichment job if possible. cc @leah

leah (customer-success): messaged primary contact, they confirmed a mis-scheduled job and said they can pause immediately. they asked for ETA to stabilize.

jay (runtime-eng): after RL bump, 1m QPS to yukon dropped contention, 5xx rate decreased from 6% -> 0.5% within 90s. p95 latency improving.

sophie (oncall-sre): great. keep watch for token exhaustion or cache blowups. if errors spike again we can apply short-lived feature disable for large-context endpoints for that org.

marco (support): customer confirmed pause. they will run smaller incremental job in 2h. appreciated.

jay (runtime-eng): setting auto-rollback timer + alert: will auto-revert at +30m unless escalated. also creating a canary rule to re-enable stricter per-prefix qps if pattern repeats.

sophie (oncall-sre): created incident ticket INC-6072136543 and annotated mitigation steps. leaving runbook entries for postmortem: include customer-scheduled-job, RL profile, suggested quota guardrails.

leah (customer-success): customer asked for a note that we proactively adjusted RL and will revert; they asked for a short summary for their ops team. i'll draft and send. :white_check_mark:

jay (runtime-eng): manual check at +10m looked clean. no secondary spikes. metrics stable.

sophie (oncall-sre): handing off to night oncall @morgan in 20m with context. morg will monitor rollback and close incident after verification.

deploy-bot: auto-rollback scheduled at ts=6072138343 (30m).

sophie (oncall-sre): final note: mitigation = temporary org-level RL override + prefix caching + customer paused heavy job. action items: (1) follow up postmortem, (2) propose quota alert threshold for yukon-01, (3) update onboarding doc about scheduled job detection.

marco (support): thanks team. marking as mitigated for customer-facing comms.

leah (customer-success): sent summary to customer, they acknowledged and appreciated the quick response. closing customer loop after postmortem. :pray:
